scripts.dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d mailpit && npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @catalogue/api" "npm run dev -w @catalogue/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @catalogue/api -w @catalogue/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run build:contracts && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
